parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The new description of the list.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the custom list, which can be obtained by calling the [ListLists](~~2850217~~) operation.

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: The items in the updated list. The value is a JSON array.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The new name of the list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-list --id 40000001 --name example --description a_custom_list --items 10.1.1.1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa UpdateList --region cn-hangzhou --Description a_custom_list --Items '["10.1.1.1"]' --Id 40000001 --Name example
